output.summary: The claim was denied because bariatric surgery is excluded under the policy. To move forward, gather supporting medical evidence and follow the insurer’s internal review process, noting that the policy currently provides no explicit appeal basis.

items.text: Provide recent BMI measurements, weight‑loss history, and documentation of obesity‑related comorbidities to determine if an exception to the exclusion can be considered.
Submit the additional medical records to the insurer’s review department and request an internal review of the exclusion determination.
The policy’s exclusion clause offers no explicit appeal pathway, so any appeal may be limited under the EXCLUSION_NO_BASIS gate.
